United's new Family Plan saves you
⅓ for your wife, ⅓ for your children
Here's how it works weekdays - From noon Mon-
day through noon Friday, head of family pays full jet
Coach fare. Wife pays ⅔ the regular fare, children two
through 21, ⅓ the regular fare.
New weekend plan - From 12:01 a.m. Saturday
through noon Sunday, head of family pays full jet Coach
fare. Wife pays ¾ the regular fare, children two through
11, 2 the regular fare, and children 12 through 21, ¾
the regular fare.
Use your Bank Americard, Diners Club, Carte Blanche,
American Express or United's Fly Now Pay Later plan to
charge your trip.
